title: fix(console): in-app doc links keep the app shell; docs chrome reads the session language
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu4MbnkfHMbgaMJXYX2yp8UL)_
Fixes #30554

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：在应用里看文档时，正文里的文档链接改为指向当前应用的文档路由，点开后顶栏和应用菜单都还在；文档页头部的「Documentation」、文档门户标题和侧栏的「Uncategorized」分组改为按会话语言显示（10 种语言都补了词）。
- 为什么改：之前正文链接一律指向全局文档门户 `/docs/NAME`，用户在 HotCRM 手册里点「线索」会跳出应用、只能靠浏览器后退；中文界面里还夹着两个英文词。
- 风险与回滚：只改控制台文档页的链接目标和三处文案，路由形状不变、不碰 `packages/**`；门户（应用外）的链接保持原样；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/apps/console/src/pages/DocPage.tsx`（链接基点 `base` 与点击跳转）、`ui/apps/console/src/pages/DocShell.tsx`（头部首页链接）、`ui/apps/console/src/pages/book-nav.ts`（`labelUncategorized` 按 key 取名）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/DocPage.docLinkBasename-12686.test.tsx apps/console/src/pages/docs-portal.bookLocale-26690.test.tsx`，预期 2 个文件 16 条全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Body cross-references inside an app stay in the app.** `DocPage` rewrote `[x](./other_doc.md)` with `useHref('/docs')`, the portal, even when the page was read under `/apps/APP/docs/BOOK/DOC` (ADR-0048). It now resolves them under the route it is read under (`/apps/APP/docs` inside an app, `/docs` outside), basename included as before (objectui#12686); a plain left click navigates to the same base. The flat `APP/docs/NAME` segment already redirects to the doc's in-book URL under that base (`DocsSlug`), so the reader lands on `/apps/APP/docs/BOOK/NAME` with the top bar and the app navigation.
- **The header's home link is the app's docs index inside an app** (`DocShell`), the same defect class as the body links, in a claimed file: before, it also pointed at the portal and left the app. Outside an app it is still `/docs`.
- **The docs chrome reads the session language.** New keys `help.documentation` and `help.uncategorized` in all ten locale packs. `DocShell`'s home label and the `DocsIndex` heading read the first; the book sidebar's synthetic catch-all group is titled with the second by its key (`labelUncategorized` in the console's resolver copy `book-nav.ts`), so the resolver's English label stays as authored and authored groups keep the server's translation (`translateBook`, objectstack#26690).

No server change: the body links were rewritten in the console, not server-side, so the card stays in the ui lane whole.

## Tests

- `DocPage.docLinkBasename-12686.test.tsx` (the DocPage link harness), new top-level describe: under `/_console` an app doc's body link is the href react-router's own `Link` renders for `/apps/APP/docs/NAME`; a left click lands in the app route, never the portal; root mount; the header home link is the app's docs index; CONTROL: outside an app the home link is still the portal.
- `docs-portal.bookLocale-26690.test.tsx` (the docs locale harness, real route table, layout, reader and sidebar), new top-level describe: under a real `I18nProvider` for zh, ja and es the sidebar's Uncategorized group and the header home link read the pack's words (expectations read from the packs, guarded as non-English); CONTROL with no provider reads English. This harness's `useObjectTranslation` stub (defaultValue only) was dropped so the provider can answer; its two existing cases are unchanged and still pass. One unplaced doc was added to its fixture to put an Uncategorized group on screen.

## Acceptance notes

- Still English, outside this card's two rows, not filed (polish of the same pages): the `DocsIndex` subtitle "Books and guides from your installed packages.", the "Documentation not found" / "Failed to load documentation" notices in `DocPage` / `DocsSlug`, and the narrow-screen disclosure's fallback "Contents" in `DocPage`.
- Studio's doc-draft preview (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/doc-draft.ts`) resolves through the spec's `resolveBookTree` and would show its synthetic group as "Uncategorized"; not in this claim's file surface, noted only.
- Branch is the card thread's platform-assigned `claude/project-thread-y9p3c7`, not `claude/issue-30554-*`; the claim amendment names it.

## Verification

<details><summary>Live rig on origin/main vs this branch (showcase + console dev server, zh-CN)</summary>

Showcase `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` with a temporary unplaced doc (never committed) that links `./showcase_index.md`; console Vite dev server proxied to it; Playwright signed in as the seeded admin with the console language set to zh-CN, opened `/apps/com.example.showcase/docs/showcase_rig_note`, read the header, the sidebar group titles and the body links, then clicked the body link.

Before (base c23eafa8):
- body link href `/docs/showcase_index`; after the click the path is `/docs/manual/showcase_index`, app help button absent, app sidebar absent (left the app shell)
- header home link text `Documentation`, href `/docs`
- sidebar groups `入门, 导览, 指南, Uncategorized`

After (this branch):
- body link href `/apps/com.example.showcase/docs/showcase_index`; after the click the path is `/apps/com.example.showcase/docs/manual/showcase_index`, app help button present, app sidebar present
- header home link text `文档`, href `/apps/com.example.showcase/docs`
- sidebar groups `入门, 导览, 指南, 未分类`
- en-US control: `Documentation`, `Getting Started, Guided Tour, Guides, Uncategorized`, links in the app route

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (fix reverted, tests kept)</summary>

`DocPage.tsx`, `DocShell.tsx`, `book-nav.ts` and `DocsIndex.tsx` restored to base c23eafa8 (disk hash = base blob for all four), the two test files run: 8 failed / 8 passed — every new case red except the outside-app CONTROL, which holds on both trees. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, each file's hash re-checked equal to its HEAD blob.

</details>

<details><summary>Local runs at e2e20122</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n apps/console/src/pages/Doc apps/console/src/pages/docs apps/console/src/pages/book-nav apps/console/src/pages/BookSidebar apps/console/src/pages/doc-`: Test Files 110 passed, Tests 1557 passed / 13 skipped
- `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/console --filter=@object-ui/i18n`: 75/75 tasks successful
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on every changed file: 0 errors (2 pre-existing `no-explicit-any` warnings in `DocPage.tsx`, untouched lines)
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 35 derived, each run with exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN
- merge-tree against origin/main 48b3ae6e: clean

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No spec change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (Changed files linted locally; the repo-wide run is CI's.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (The 维护者速读 block is the dispatch contract's Chinese summary.)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
